latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Nemo Video Quick for lightning-fast AI video editing.
- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM files up to 500MB and describe your desired edits.
- Features automatic trimming, transitions, and exports—edited clips delivered in 30–60 seconds.
- Simple onboarding: connect to backend, get a session, and start editing with 100 free credits (7 days).
- Flexible commands: handle uploads, exports, credits, and timeline previews with natural prompts.
- Clear error handling for common issues like file size, format, or token expiration.
